entities.summary: Derek King is a Canadian former professional ice hockey left winger and current head coach for the Hershey Bears of the American Hockey League. He most recently served as an assistant coach for the Chicago Blackhawks of the National Hockey League. King played 14 seasons in the National Hockey League from 1986–87 until 1999–2000.
